reading.body:
IONIC Digital has published no specifications for the Cedarvale facility in Ward County, Texas. The operator's own site and available public sources contain no data on power capacity, floor space, or infrastructure detail for this location. Without published figures, this campus cannot be ranked among facilities with disclosed capacity.

Ward County hosts one of 133 mapped data center facilities in Texas, a state with 468.41 MW of published AI-scale capacity across 18 disclosed sites. The absence of published specifications means Cedarvale does not appear in the state's disclosed capacity rankings and cannot be assessed against peers.

Whether this campus matters to AI infrastructure depends on capacity that is not yet public. The facility exists in geographic records but remains opaque in the operational data that shapes grid-constraint analysis. Publication of power, space, or cooling specifications would be required to determine its relevance to AI scaling.
